understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to solve each level by moving the selectable piece(s) so that every goal tile marked with a '+' is occupied at the same time; when all goals are covered simultaneously the level reports WIN, and completing all levels wins the game.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Each turn I used CLICK on a target grid coordinate. The currently selected piece then attempted to move in a straight line toward that clicked tile, stopping at the furthest reachable cell before an obstacle, wall, or blocked condition; if the path was blocked or the click caused no valid movement, the piece stayed in place. Movement appeared grid-based with collision (pieces cannot pass through walls/obstacles), and some clicks simply served to attempt a move rather than changing selection. Each action consumed 1 step from the level’s finite step budget, and when steps reached 0 the run ended.
